anomalies.description: A white box truck enters the intersection from the left and collides with a dark sedan that is turning or stopped in the intersection; the impact is visible as the truck pushes the sedan sideways.
A light blue sedan in the left lane loses control, swerves sharply right across the lane markings, and collides with the central median barrier, producing visible debris/sparks at impact.
A white car loses control on a rural road, veers off the pavement to the right, and crashes into the grassy field, kicking up a large cloud of dust and debris.
A white car ahead loses control, veers right off the road, kicks up dust, and rolls multiple times in the field, resulting in a severe crash.

A vehicle loses control on a rural road, veers off the pavement to the right, and rolls multiple times in the adjacent field, generating a large dust cloud that obscures the vehicle by frame f4.; On a multi-lane highway, a white hatchback in the left lane abruptly swerves right across lane markings, narrowly avoiding a collision with a silver sedan ahead and to its left; the maneuver appears evasive and dangerous.

A yellow truck on the left side of the road loses control, veers sharply right, and collides with a white bus ahead, causing a violent impact that ejects debris and dust, followed by the camera vehicle being struck or enveloped in the resulting cloud.
